selection_disclosure: V3 mixed exact-expiry and bounded term-interpolated diagnostics and produced no validated trade cohort. V4 starts at zero and permits only exact listed Deribit expiries to become executable evidence; bounded term interpolation remains an explicitly excluded diagnostic lane.

target_rules.contracts: BTC and ETH threshold markets with a rule-certified resolver source and target timestamp exactly equal to a listed Deribit option expiry
target_rules.fidelity_required: A: exact expiry with complete executable bid/ask IV interval
target_rules.entry_benchmark: conservative fair lower bound - executable Polymarket ask - doubled dynamic taker fee - perpetual hedge stress > 0

model.strike_interpolation: log strike inside the exact-expiry surface
model.uncertainty: Deribit bid/ask IV interval plus resolver-basis interval
model.hedge: quantified perpetual delta hedge with residual binary gamma, basis risk and 5bp cost stress
model.exit: terminal token resolution plus recorded hedge PnL; no claimed-fair markout

persistence.raw_events: append-before-parse immutable WAL at source fidelity
persistence.derived_sql: initial state, stable state transitions and bounded 60s executable/300s diagnostic heartbeats
persistence.purpose: retain deterministic replay while preventing repetitive derived rows from exhausting the hot database

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across asset, side and expiry band
evaluation.null_outcome: The exact options surface may add no tradable residual beyond the prediction-market quote.
